question_set.question: Use trace_node with node_name equal to Rejected Energy and use trace_node with node_name equal to Generation Loss and use calculate_conversion_rate with node_name equal to Power Generation in order to know Analyze the energy loss distribution in the national energy system and discuss which stages have the greatest potential for energy conservation.

answer.value: The national energy system shows significant losses at multiple stages. Power Generation is the largest loss point with 103 EJ lost (62% of its 165 EJ input), resulting in only 37.6% generation efficiency. The second major loss is Rejected Energy at end-use stage (73 EJ), primarily from Motive Power (38 EJ), Other Uses (14 EJ), and Heating (11 EJ). The overall system efficiency is only 31.2% (89 EJ useful output from 285 EJ input). The greatest conservation potential lies in: (1) improving power generation efficiency, (2) enhancing motive power efficiency in transport and industry, and (3) reducing heating losses through better insulation and heat recovery systems.

key_insights: Power Generation loses 103 EJ (62% of input)
Rejected Energy totals 73 EJ mainly from Motive Power
Greatest conservation potential in power generation and motive power sectors

reasoning_trace.rationale: Trace the sources of Rejected Energy to identify end-use losses
Trace the sources of Generation Loss to understand power sector inefficiency
Calculate conversion rate at Power Generation to quantify generation efficiency
